scope: Six requested current-code requirements plus observedN13; historical lack-of-test/status is not current missing implementation. Physical/live gates and whole requirement clauses stay pending individually.

originalRequirement.title: 思いつきを一時置きする
originalRequirement.provenance: 調査提案の仕様化・PRレビュー対象
originalRequirement.shall: 作品内の受け皿へ、短い文章・画像・音声メモを保存する。あとから人物、場面、伏線へ変換し、元のメモも参照できること。
originalRequirement.failure_behavior: 録音を拒否した端末でも文章を保存できる。変換は元メモを消さず、元と変換先のIDを結ぶ。

independentCurrentAssessment.assessment: implementation present; exact scene conversion local normal/negative observed; whole requirement and original actual sync not certified
independentCurrentAssessment.evidence: AT-F01 local 390px ordinary App actualPNG/WAV→note→linked scene→native atomic fail/retry→Library/cold/new/clone/re-export passed. Other planned conversion targets remain to execute in selected/current normal suites; actual smartphone→PC sync/recording/Files not_run.

given.literalExpected: 文章メモ「塔の鍵は鳥が持つ」、画像1枚、音声1件をスマートフォンで保存した作品
observations: Exact sentence 塔の鍵は鳥が持つ and real PNG/WAV created through ordinary App at 390px. Physical smartphone recording/OS Files not_run.

when.literalExpected: メモから場面へ変換し、別端末で同期後の変換元と変換先を開く
observations: Normal note-to-scene conversion and immutable origin reference verified. New/clone portable restoration is not original two-device synchronization.

then.literalExpected: スマートフォンで一文を残し、PCで場面へ変えても元のメモを追える。
observations: Origin note/body/attachment IDs, converted scene and reference relation survived atomic save/cold/new/clone/re-export. Actual smartphone-to-PC synchronization not_run.

negative_or_edge.literalExpected: 録音を拒否した端末でも文章を保存できる。変換は元メモを消さず、元と変換先のIDを結ぶ。
observations: Synthetic microphone NotAllowedError blocked recording but allowed sentence save. Quota conversion failure preserved all native rows and draft, then retry succeeded. Origin note retained; distinct scene/body IDs linked through convertedToIds and reference relation. Real OS permission not_run.

originalRequirement.title: 構成の雛形と盛り上がりを見る
originalRequirement.provenance: 調査提案の仕様化・PRレビュー対象
originalRequirement.shall: 物語の構成を雛形から選び、自由に変更する。場面の緊張度や重要度を自分で付け、選んだ進行順で偏りを確認すること。
originalRequirement.failure_behavior: 雛形適用は別案または差分確認を経る。緊張度の未入力をゼロと集計せず算出母数を示す。

independentCurrentAssessment.assessment: implementation present; original AT-F05 local original normal/negative directly passed
independentCurrentAssessment.evidence: 2/8/null, two author alternatives, template cancel and explicit apply,2/3 measured denominator, atomic fail/retry, saved alternative/cold/fullfile passed. This does not certify all long paths/current importance values/all platforms beyond original exact case.

given.literalExpected: 緊張度2/8/未入力の三場面と一つの構成雛形
observations: Exact authored tension 2/8/null, three scenes, one chapter/template, two alternatives.

when.literalExpected: 別案に雛形を適用して章順を変え、緊張度の表示と算出対象を確認する
observations: Ordinary alternative template preview/cancel preserved order; explicit apply changed only selected alternative to 8/2/null. Atomic save, cold and empty complete-file restore retained head.

then.literalExpected: 表示は作者が付けた値から作り、作品の良し悪しを自動採点しない。
observations: Display matched authored 2/8/missing; measured denominator 2/3 and one missing. Canonical order preserved; no automatic quality score substituted.

negative_or_edge.literalExpected: 雛形適用は別案または差分確認を経る。緊張度の未入力をゼロと集計せず算出母数を示す。
observations: Cancel preserved order, explicit apply only changed the alternative, null stayed null with an unfilled chart circle rather than zero. Quota refusal preserved all native rows and draft; retry/cold/fullfile retained earlier version.

originalRequirement.title: 画面の広さに合わせて編集する
originalRequirement.provenance: 調査提案の仕様化・PRレビュー対象
originalRequirement.shall: 広い画面は一覧・図・詳細、iPadは二画面、スマートフォンは図と詳細を切り替える。縦横と分割表示にも合わせること。
originalRequirement.failure_behavior: 端末の幅で表示を切り替え、重要操作をPCに限定しない。分割表示やソフトキーボードで確定ボタンが隠れない。

independentCurrentAssessment.assessment: implementation present with reproduced current320 reflow difference
independentCurrentAssessment.evidence: 390/768/1024/1440 full procedure passed.320 failed with pageoverflow58 after relation keyboard save; typed-reference middle strong does not wrap.320200%/cold phase not_run due failure. Actual rotation/SplitView/software keyboard/OS Files not_run.

given.literalExpected: 人物/条件/関係線/専用ファイルを持つ作品と未保存入力
observations: Person, typed condition, saved relation, native complete file and unsaved draft supplied.

when.literalExpected: 幅320/390/768/1024/1440、縦横/分割で配置を切替え、狭幅だけで編集と読み込みを完了する
observations: 390/768/1024/1440 completed normal keyboard save,200% text,complete import,cold. At320 condition/relation save passed, but58px page overflow stopped later phases. Physical rotation/SplitView/software keyboard not_run.

then.literalExpected: 人物、条件、関係線、読み込みの編集を、スマートフォンだけでも完了できる。
observations: At320 person/typed condition/relation editing saved via keyboard; remaining 200%/file+cold not executed because original page reflow failure.

negative_or_edge.literalExpected: 端末の幅で表示を切り替え、重要操作をPCに限定しない。分割表示やソフトキーボードで確定ボタンが隠れない。
observations: Required320 reflow fails with reference labelright378.14 and pageoverflow58. Native Quota failure invariant/draft retention and keyboard retry passed. Real software keyboard overlap and SplitView not_run.

originalRequirement.title: 条件を組み立て、成立理由を見る
originalRequirement.provenance: 調査提案の仕様化・PRレビュー対象
originalRequirement.shall: 「すべて」「どれか」「否定」を入れ子で選び、条件を自然文と式で確認する。複数成立時の優先順、全実行か一つか、不成立時の行き先を決めること。
originalRequirement.failure_behavior: 括弧・優先順・不成立時処理を明示する。未知を偽にしない三値評価を行い、任意のコードを条件として実行しない。

independentCurrentAssessment.assessment: implementation present; original AT-F40 local original normal/negative directly passed
independentCurrentAssessment.evidence: Original boolean/昼夜enum/all(any) typed controls, parentheses,true/false/unknown/author reason, two simultaneous auto candidates, priority tie atomic refusal, fallback=null and arbitrary script no-execution passed including cold. Whole requirement all/not/all_match/limits coverage is tracked separately, not inferred from one case.

given.literalExpected: 鍵booleanと時刻enum昼/夜、同時成立する自動候補2件
observations: Original key boolean, clock enum 昼/夜 and two simultaneous automatic candidates with explicit distinct priority.

when.literalExpected: all(鍵,any(昼,夜))を作り真/偽/不明、優先同値、fallbackなしを順に評価する
observations: Typed controls created all(key,any(day,night)); false/unknown/true, tie refusal and fallback=null were evaluated sequentially. Expected A reached intended terminal; cold parentheses retained.

then.literalExpected: 「鍵あり、かつ、昼または夜」の括弧を明示する。今の値で選択肢が出ない理由を説明する。
observations: Exact parenthesized Japanese all/any description, false no-fallback explanation and exact unknown author reason matched.

negative_or_edge.literalExpected: 括弧・優先順・不成立時処理を明示する。未知を偽にしない三値評価を行い、任意のコードを条件として実行しない。
observations: Equal priority refused atomically with all rows unchanged. Script condition disabled save and never ran sentinel. Unknown stayed unknown. Gate/fallback persisted; original entity IDs/order retained and generated reviews have unique IDs and original targets.
